Islam means submission to the will of God; while the name of a believer of the religion is known as a Muslim.

Wealth and children are an ornament of life, the sight for reward, and better in respect of hope.

Man is a responsible, dignified and honourable agent of his Creator.

A Patriarch is the father and head of a family or tribe.

Eros is a Greek word used for a kind of love among people.

LORD is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.

The Bible is the source of love which you must emulate.

Jesus Christ is the model of Christian morality.

Health is a serious matter which involves all human beings.
